I am a nurse myself and I always do my research before committing to any treatments. While the result from shugao technique cannot be compared to Botox injection, it is for those who value non invasive, natural beauty methods. Shugao technique is highly specialised and it doesn’t stop at just lymphatic drainage massage, it goes deeper into your connective tissues/muscles to achieve myofascial release and facial realignment. To reach the deep fascia and muscle knots, practitioners must apply a certain level of strength. I have been to other places which claim to be Kogao qualified but actually felt just like another average massage. Teresa is highly experienced and skilled. She has been showing me her refined techniques from her years of experience. Her gentle hands first relax my muscles before applying the right amount of pressure to sculpt my face. It can hurt sometimes but that’s what it should be. Note that stronger does not always mean better. There’s a fine line between ineffectiveness and injury. And that is exactly why you need a skilled and qualified specialist. Teresa knows exactly what to do. You can definitely trust her 100%. On top of the above, she is also a lovely lady who is so approachable and genuinely cares for her clients. I am glad that I found her and I will not go anywhere else.

Teresa is incredibly talented, gentle and passionate about what she does. I always leave feeling refreshed, confident and looking forward to my next appointment. Highly recommended!
